verdict.rationale: Epic's Blueprints Visual Scripting docs say designers can use virtually the full range of concepts and tools otherwise available only to programmers, and functions can be defined and implemented entirely in Blueprint. Community users confirm Blueprints work for real logic but note limits: performance suffers as complexity grows, some tasks (vehicles, file/JSON I/O) push users toward C++, and one comment calls them best for prototyping. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation in the pack beyond a single summary line, and independent evidence that complex, production-scale gameplay can be built without any C++.
